verdict.rationale: Conta Simples markets boleto payment, batch payments, free Pix and an 'Área de aprovações' (approvals area), and offers supplier management. This suggests a basic payables workflow on Brazilian payment rails within the same platform. The evidence is a single marketing line plus API docs focused on cards, statements and classification. Invoice linking applies only to existing transactions, not to capturing incoming bills, and ACH, check and wire are never mentioned. Missing for 10: dedicated invoice/bill capture and intake, documented approval-routing rules for payables, vendor payment by ACH, check or wire, in-depth AP documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
